legalBaseline.scope: Articles 77-78 and Annex XIII; battery passport scope, access, QR/UID and technical operation
DPP framework and registry architecture referenced by the Batteries Regulation

legalBaseline.source: European Commission Digital Batteries Passport - data points by category v2.0 (2026-08-15)

conformanceRule: No EU compliant/certified claim is produced by this file. Every populated externally asserted technical value requires provenance and evidence. Harmonised-standard clauses remain unverified until licensed normative text is reviewed.
